purpose: Teach: プロダクション/自負/特長/館長/主語/一部分/コンセンサス/求む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、映像プロダクションでのインターンも経験しろ
lines.en: Ren, get some experience interning at a video production company.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Lean forward slightly. Eye contact that expects absorption. No room for negotiation, but delivered with quiet faith in his capability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の質に自負を持って取り組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll approach my lab work with real pride in its quality.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Careful, deliberate pacing. Slight tension in the delivery — he's committing to this, feeling the weight of it. Soft finish, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の特長を明確に提示しろ
lines.en: Ren, make the paper's strengths crystal clear.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. No softening. The tone of someone who knows exactly what needs fixing. Brief pause after his name — let it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。資料館長との対談を企画しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm arranging an interview with the archive director.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath the formality. He's thought this through. Steady rhythm, no rushing to prove himself. Pride held just beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の主語を明確にしろ
lines.en: Ren, clarify your paper's subject from the start.
lines.style: Direct, cutting through. Each word lands. The exasperation of someone who sees the problem clearly. Not unkind, just — this matters, pay attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の一部分を再構成します
lines.en: Yes. I'll restructure a section of the paper.
lines.style: Subdued acceptance. He knows this is right even though it stings. Formal politeness that masks a small internal sigh. Steady, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のコンセンサスを取って進めろ
lines.en: Ren, get buy-in from your lab before you move forward.
lines.style: Settling into wisdom. This isn't criticism — it's the voice of someone who's learned the hard way. Patient but firm. The tone of giving real advice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究助手「求む」の告知も出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll post the recruitment notice for research assistants too.
lines.style: Bracing himself. There's a lot of work ahead and he feels it. Determination creeping back in despite the tiredness. Closing statement — a breath like turning a page.
